parts.text:
Current X-Ray project ID: job-1b0c3d86-4ecf-4be8-9297-cd9f74c616a3
Continue AB-01 in the same project. Preserve the completed U-shaped two-storey structure and stairwell. This is stage 2, an illustrative benchmark. Work through actual tools, save, inspect and mount the final Model in solid view; capture the real result.

Add exactly six doors: three on each level, one centered on each of the west-wing, east-wing and north-wing courtyard-facing walls. Each door is 1.2 m wide by 2.4 m high. For this geometric benchmark, the upper-level doors are conceptual openings; do not claim compliant access or constructability. Add twelve windows: six per level, two on each outer west, north and east wall, evenly distributed and clear of doors. Each is 1.8 m wide by 1.5 m high with a 0.9 m sill.

Build one straight internal stair inside the reserved west-wing void: 24 rises of 150 mm reaching the upper floor, with 23 visible treads, each 1.2 m wide, 300 mm deep and 50 mm thick. The uppermost tread must meet the upper-floor landing without a horizontal gap. Do not fill the stairwell or put a floor over the treads. Use supported geometry and clearly disclose whether the stair is a native stair object or a geometric approximation.

Add a rectangular 32 m by 26 m site slab, giving 4 m margins around the building, with top at -0.3 m and thickness 0.2 m. Inside the courtyard add one 6 m by 3 m pond with water surface at -0.1 m, and two separate raised planted beds, each 4 m by 1 m with top at +0.6 m. Keep them clear of each other and entry doors. Give water and planting explicit material names, and report if the renderer cannot display them distinctly. No extra levels, walls, fake source evidence, unrelated catalog buildings, images in place of geometry, or construction-ready claims. Read the final saved design and report actual counts and remaining limitations.

Current X-Ray project ID: job-1b0c3d86-4ecf-4be8-9297-cd9f74c616a3
Continue AB-01 in the same project. Preserve the completed U-shaped two-storey structure and stairwell. This is stage 2, an illustrative benchmark. Work through actual tools, save, inspect and mount the final Model in solid view; capture the real result.

Add exactly six doors: three on each level, one centered on each of the west-wing, east-wing and north-wing courtyard-facing walls. Each door is 1.2 m wide by 2.4 m high. For this geometric benchmark, the upper-level doors are conceptual openings; do not claim compliant access or constructability. Add twelve windows: six per level, two on each outer west, north and east wall, evenly distributed and clear of doors. Each is 1.8 m wide by 1.5 m high with a 0.9 m sill.

Build one straight internal stair inside the reserved west-wing void: 24 rises of 150 mm reaching the upper floor, with 23 visible treads, each 1.2 m wide, 300 mm deep and 50 mm thick. The uppermost tread must meet the upper-floor landing without a horizontal gap. Do not fill the stairwell or put a floor over the treads. Use supported geometry and clearly disclose whether the stair is a native stair object or a geometric approximation.

Add a rectangular 32 m by 26 m site slab, giving 4 m margins around the building, with top at -0.3 m and thickness 0.2 m. Inside the courtyard add one 6 m by 3 m pond with water surface at -0.1 m, and two separate raised planted beds, each 4 m by 1 m with top at +0.6 m. Keep them clear of each other and entry doors. Give water and planting explicit material names, and report if the renderer cannot display them distinctly. No extra levels, walls, fake source evidence, unrelated catalog buildings, images in place of geometry, or construction-ready claims. Read the final saved design and report actual counts and remaining limitations.

Current X-Ray project ID: job-1b0c3d86-4ecf-4be8-9297-cd9f74c616a3
Continue AB-01 in the same project. Preserve the completed U-shaped two-storey structure and stairwell. This is stage 2, an illustrative benchmark. Work through actual tools, save, inspect and mount the final Model in solid view; capture the real result.

Add exactly six doors: three on each level, one centered on each of the west-wing, east-wing and north-wing courtyard-facing walls. Each door is 1.2 m wide by 2.4 m high. For this geometric benchmark, the upper-level doors are conceptual openings; do not claim compliant access or constructability. Add twelve windows: six per level, two on each outer west, north and east wall, evenly distributed and clear of doors. Each is 1.8 m wide by 1.5 m high with a 0.9 m sill.

Build one straight internal stair inside the reserved west-wing void: 24 rises of 150 mm reaching the upper floor, with 23 visible treads, each 1.2 m wide, 300 mm deep and 50 mm thick. The uppermost tread must meet the upper-floor landing without a horizontal gap. Do not fill the stairwell or put a floor over the treads. Use supported geometry and clearly disclose whether the stair is a native stair object or a geometric approximation.

Add a rectangular 32 m by 26 m site slab, giving 4 m margins around the building, with top at -0.3 m and thickness 0.2 m. Inside the courtyard add one 6 m by 3 m pond with water surface at -0.1 m, and two separate raised planted beds, each 4 m by 1 m with top at +0.6 m. Keep them clear of each other and entry doors. Give water and planting explicit material names, and report if the renderer cannot display them distinctly. No extra levels, walls, fake source evidence, unrelated catalog buildings, images in place of geometry, or construction-ready claims. Read the final saved design and report actual counts and remaining limitations.

Current X-Ray project ID: job-1b0c3d86-4ecf-4be8-9297-cd9f74c616a3
Continue AB-01 in the same project. Preserve the completed U-shaped two-storey structure and stairwell. This is stage 2, an illustrative benchmark. Work through actual tools, save, inspect and mount the final Model in solid view; capture the real result.

Add exactly six doors: three on each level, one centered on each of the west-wing, east-wing and north-wing courtyard-facing walls. Each door is 1.2 m wide by 2.4 m high. For this geometric benchmark, the upper-level doors are conceptual openings; do not claim compliant access or constructability. Add twelve windows: six per level, two on each outer west, north and east wall, evenly distributed and clear of doors. Each is 1.8 m wide by 1.5 m high with a 0.9 m sill.

Build one straight internal stair inside the reserved west-wing void: 24 rises of 150 mm reaching the upper floor, with 23 visible treads, each 1.2 m wide, 300 mm deep and 50 mm thick. The uppermost tread must meet the upper-floor landing without a horizontal gap. Do not fill the stairwell or put a floor over the treads. Use supported geometry and clearly disclose whether the stair is a native stair object or a geometric approximation.

Add a rectangular 32 m by 26 m site slab, giving 4 m margins around the building, with top at -0.3 m and thickness 0.2 m. Inside the courtyard add one 6 m by 3 m pond with water surface at -0.1 m, and two separate raised planted beds, each 4 m by 1 m with top at +0.6 m. Keep them clear of each other and entry doors. Give water and planting explicit material names, and report if the renderer cannot display them distinctly. No extra levels, walls, fake source evidence, unrelated catalog buildings, images in place of geometry, or construction-ready claims. Read the final saved design and report actual counts and remaining limitations.

Current X-Ray project ID: job-1b0c3d86-4ecf-4be8-9297-cd9f74c616a3
Continue AB-01 in the same project. Preserve the completed U-shaped two-storey structure and stairwell. This is stage 2, an illustrative benchmark. Work through actual tools, save, inspect and mount the final Model in solid view; capture the real result.

Add exactly six doors: three on each level, one centered on each of the west-wing, east-wing and north-wing courtyard-facing walls. Each door is 1.2 m wide by 2.4 m high. For this geometric benchmark, the upper-level doors are conceptual openings; do not claim compliant access or constructability. Add twelve windows: six per level, two on each outer west, north and east wall, evenly distributed and clear of doors. Each is 1.8 m wide by 1.5 m high with a 0.9 m sill.

Build one straight internal stair inside the reserved west-wing void: 24 rises of 150 mm reaching the upper floor, with 23 visible treads, each 1.2 m wide, 300 mm deep and 50 mm thick. The uppermost tread must meet the upper-floor landing without a horizontal gap. Do not fill the stairwell or put a floor over the treads. Use supported geometry and clearly disclose whether the stair is a native stair object or a geometric approximation.

Add a rectangular 32 m by 26 m site slab, giving 4 m margins around the building, with top at -0.3 m and thickness 0.2 m. Inside the courtyard add one 6 m by 3 m pond with water surface at -0.1 m, and two separate raised planted beds, each 4 m by 1 m with top at +0.6 m. Keep them clear of each other and entry doors. Give water and planting explicit material names, and report if the renderer cannot display them distinctly. No extra levels, walls, fake source evidence, unrelated catalog buildings, images in place of geometry, or construction-ready claims. Read the final saved design and report actual counts and remaining limitations.

Current X-Ray project ID: job-1b0c3d86-4ecf-4be8-9297-cd9f74c616a3
Continue AB-01 in the same project. Preserve the completed U-shaped two-storey structure and stairwell. This is stage 2, an illustrative benchmark. Work through actual tools, save, inspect and mount the final Model in solid view; capture the real result.

Add exactly six doors: three on each level, one centered on each of the west-wing, east-wing and north-wing courtyard-facing walls. Each door is 1.2 m wide by 2.4 m high. For this geometric benchmark, the upper-level doors are conceptual openings; do not claim compliant access or constructability. Add twelve windows: six per level, two on each outer west, north and east wall, evenly distributed and clear of doors. Each is 1.8 m wide by 1.5 m high with a 0.9 m sill.

Build one straight internal stair inside the reserved west-wing void: 24 rises of 150 mm reaching the upper floor, with 23 visible treads, each 1.2 m wide, 300 mm deep and 50 mm thick. The uppermost tread must meet the upper-floor landing without a horizontal gap. Do not fill the stairwell or put a floor over the treads. Use supported geometry and clearly disclose whether the stair is a native stair object or a geometric approximation.

Add a rectangular 32 m by 26 m site slab, giving 4 m margins around the building, with top at -0.3 m and thickness 0.2 m. Inside the courtyard add one 6 m by 3 m pond with water surface at -0.1 m, and two separate raised planted beds, each 4 m by 1 m with top at +0.6 m. Keep them clear of each other and entry doors. Give water and planting explicit material names, and report if the renderer cannot display them distinctly. No extra levels, walls, fake source evidence, unrelated catalog buildings, images in place of geometry, or construction-ready claims. Read the final saved design and report actual counts and remaining limitations.

Current X-Ray project ID: job-1b0c3d86-4ecf-4be8-9297-cd9f74c616a3
Continue AB-01 in the same project. Preserve the completed U-shaped two-storey structure and stairwell. This is stage 2, an illustrative benchmark. Work through actual tools, save, inspect and mount the final Model in solid view; capture the real result.

Add exactly six doors: three on each level, one centered on each of the west-wing, east-wing and north-wing courtyard-facing walls. Each door is 1.2 m wide by 2.4 m high. For this geometric benchmark, the upper-level doors are conceptual openings; do not claim compliant access or constructability. Add twelve windows: six per level, two on each outer west, north and east wall, evenly distributed and clear of doors. Each is 1.8 m wide by 1.5 m high with a 0.9 m sill.

Build one straight internal stair inside the reserved west-wing void: 24 rises of 150 mm reaching the upper floor, with 23 visible treads, each 1.2 m wide, 300 mm deep and 50 mm thick. The uppermost tread must meet the upper-floor landing without a horizontal gap. Do not fill the stairwell or put a floor over the treads. Use supported geometry and clearly disclose whether the stair is a native stair object or a geometric approximation.

Add a rectangular 32 m by 26 m site slab, giving 4 m margins around the building, with top at -0.3 m and thickness 0.2 m. Inside the courtyard add one 6 m by 3 m pond with water surface at -0.1 m, and two separate raised planted beds, each 4 m by 1 m with top at +0.6 m. Keep them clear of each other and entry doors. Give water and planting explicit material names, and report if the renderer cannot display them distinctly. No extra levels, walls, fake source evidence, unrelated catalog buildings, images in place of geometry, or construction-ready claims. Read the final saved design and report actual counts and remaining limitations.

parts.text:
Current X-Ray project ID: job-1b0c3d86-4ecf-4be8-9297-cd9f74c616a3
Continue AB-01 in the same project. Preserve the completed U-shaped two-storey structure and stairwell. This is stage 2, an illustrative benchmark. Work through actual tools, save, inspect and mount the final Model in solid view; capture the real result.

Add exactly six doors: three on each level, one centered on each of the west-wing, east-wing and north-wing courtyard-facing walls. Each door is 1.2 m wide by 2.4 m high. For this geometric benchmark, the upper-level doors are conceptual openings; do not claim compliant access or constructability. Add twelve windows: six per level, two on each outer west, north and east wall, evenly distributed and clear of doors. Each is 1.8 m wide by 1.5 m high with a 0.9 m sill.

Build one straight internal stair inside the reserved west-wing void: 24 rises of 150 mm reaching the upper floor, with 23 visible treads, each 1.2 m wide, 300 mm deep and 50 mm thick. The uppermost tread must meet the upper-floor landing without a horizontal gap. Do not fill the stairwell or put a floor over the treads. Use supported geometry and clearly disclose whether the stair is a native stair object or a geometric approximation.

Add a rectangular 32 m by 26 m site slab, giving 4 m margins around the building, with top at -0.3 m and thickness 0.2 m. Inside the courtyard add one 6 m by 3 m pond with water surface at -0.1 m, and two separate raised planted beds, each 4 m by 1 m with top at +0.6 m. Keep them clear of each other and entry doors. Give water and planting explicit material names, and report if the renderer cannot display them distinctly. No extra levels, walls, fake source evidence, unrelated catalog buildings, images in place of geometry, or construction-ready claims. Read the final saved design and report actual counts and remaining limitations.

Current X-Ray project ID: job-1b0c3d86-4ecf-4be8-9297-cd9f74c616a3
Continue AB-01 in the same project. Preserve the completed U-shaped two-storey structure and stairwell. This is stage 2, an illustrative benchmark. Work through actual tools, save, inspect and mount the final Model in solid view; capture the real result.

Add exactly six doors: three on each level, one centered on each of the west-wing, east-wing and north-wing courtyard-facing walls. Each door is 1.2 m wide by 2.4 m high. For this geometric benchmark, the upper-level doors are conceptual openings; do not claim compliant access or constructability. Add twelve windows: six per level, two on each outer west, north and east wall, evenly distributed and clear of doors. Each is 1.8 m wide by 1.5 m high with a 0.9 m sill.

Build one straight internal stair inside the reserved west-wing void: 24 rises of 150 mm reaching the upper floor, with 23 visible treads, each 1.2 m wide, 300 mm deep and 50 mm thick. The uppermost tread must meet the upper-floor landing without a horizontal gap. Do not fill the stairwell or put a floor over the treads. Use supported geometry and clearly disclose whether the stair is a native stair object or a geometric approximation.

Add a rectangular 32 m by 26 m site slab, giving 4 m margins around the building, with top at -0.3 m and thickness 0.2 m. Inside the courtyard add one 6 m by 3 m pond with water surface at -0.1 m, and two separate raised planted beds, each 4 m by 1 m with top at +0.6 m. Keep them clear of each other and entry doors. Give water and planting explicit material names, and report if the renderer cannot display them distinctly. No extra levels, walls, fake source evidence, unrelated catalog buildings, images in place of geometry, or construction-ready claims. Read the final saved design and report actual counts and remaining limitations.

Continue AB-01 in the same project. Preserve the completed U-shaped two-storey structure and stairwell. This is stage 2, an illustrative benchmark. Work through actual tools, save, inspect and mount the final Model in solid view; capture the real result.

Add exactly six doors: three on each level, one centered on each of the west-wing, east-wing and north-wing courtyard-facing walls. Each door is 1.2 m wide by 2.4 m high. For this geometric benchmark, the upper-level doors are conceptual openings; do not claim compliant access or constructability. Add twelve windows: six per level, two on each outer west, north and east wall, evenly distributed and clear of doors. Each is 1.8 m wide by 1.5 m high with a 0.9 m sill.

Build one straight internal stair inside the reserved west-wing void: 24 rises of 150 mm reaching the upper floor, with 23 visible treads, each 1.2 m wide, 300 mm deep and 50 mm thick. The uppermost tread must meet the upper-floor landing without a horizontal gap. Do not fill the stairwell or put a floor over the treads. Use supported geometry and clearly disclose whether the stair is a native stair object or a geometric approximation.

Add a rectangular 32 m by 26 m site slab, giving 4 m margins around the building, with top at -0.3 m and thickness 0.2 m. Inside the courtyard add one 6 m by 3 m pond with water surface at -0.1 m, and two separate raised planted beds, each 4 m by 1 m with top at +0.6 m. Keep them clear of each other and entry doors. Give water and planting explicit material names, and report if the renderer cannot display them distinctly. No extra levels, walls, fake source evidence, unrelated catalog buildings, images in place of geometry, or construction-ready claims. Read the final saved design and report actual counts and remaining limitations.

Current X-Ray project ID: job-1b0c3d86-4ecf-4be8-9297-cd9f74c616a3
Continue AB-01 in the same project. Preserve the completed U-shaped two-storey structure and stairwell. This is stage 2, an illustrative benchmark. Work through actual tools, save, inspect and mount the final Model in solid view; capture the real result.

Add exactly six doors: three on each level, one centered on each of the west-wing, east-wing and north-wing courtyard-facing walls. Each door is 1.2 m wide by 2.4 m high. For this geometric benchmark, the upper-level doors are conceptual openings; do not claim compliant access or constructability. Add twelve windows: six per level, two on each outer west, north and east wall, evenly distributed and clear of doors. Each is 1.8 m wide by 1.5 m high with a 0.9 m sill.

Build one straight internal stair inside the reserved west-wing void: 24 rises of 150 mm reaching the upper floor, with 23 visible treads, each 1.2 m wide, 300 mm deep and 50 mm thick. The uppermost tread must meet the upper-floor landing without a horizontal gap. Do not fill the stairwell or put a floor over the treads. Use supported geometry and clearly disclose whether the stair is a native stair object or a geometric approximation.

Add a rectangular 32 m by 26 m site slab, giving 4 m margins around the building, with top at -0.3 m and thickness 0.2 m. Inside the courtyard add one 6 m by 3 m pond with water surface at -0.1 m, and two separate raised planted beds, each 4 m by 1 m with top at +0.6 m. Keep them clear of each other and entry doors. Give water and planting explicit material names, and report if the renderer cannot display them distinctly. No extra levels, walls, fake source evidence, unrelated catalog buildings, images in place of geometry, or construction-ready claims. Read the final saved design and report actual counts and remaining limitations.

Current X-Ray project ID: job-1b0c3d86-4ecf-4be8-9297-cd9f74c616a3
Continue AB-01 in the same project. Preserve the completed U-shaped two-storey structure and stairwell. This is stage 2, an illustrative benchmark. Work through actual tools, save, inspect and mount the final Model in solid view; capture the real result.

Add exactly six doors: three on each level, one centered on each of the west-wing, east-wing and north-wing courtyard-facing walls. Each door is 1.2 m wide by 2.4 m high. For this geometric benchmark, the upper-level doors are conceptual openings; do not claim compliant access or constructability. Add twelve windows: six per level, two on each outer west, north and east wall, evenly distributed and clear of doors. Each is 1.8 m wide by 1.5 m high with a 0.9 m sill.

Build one straight internal stair inside the reserved west-wing void: 24 rises of 150 mm reaching the upper floor, with 23 visible treads, each 1.2 m wide, 300 mm deep and 50 mm thick. The uppermost tread must meet the upper-floor landing without a horizontal gap. Do not fill the stairwell or put a floor over the treads. Use supported geometry and clearly disclose whether the stair is a native stair object or a geometric approximation.

Add a rectangular 32 m by 26 m site slab, giving 4 m margins around the building, with top at -0.3 m and thickness 0.2 m. Inside the courtyard add one 6 m by 3 m pond with water surface at -0.1 m, and two separate raised planted beds, each 4 m by 1 m with top at +0.6 m. Keep them clear of each other and entry doors. Give water and planting explicit material names, and report if the renderer cannot display them distinctly. No extra levels, walls, fake source evidence, unrelated catalog buildings, images in place of geometry, or construction-ready claims. Read the final saved design and report actual counts and remaining limitations.

### 🏛️ Stage 2 Model Execution & Verification

The illustrative Stage 2 architectural additions for **AB-01 Courtyard Learning Centre** have been modeled, readback-verified, and mounted in the 3D Model viewer in solid display mode.

---

### 📋 Elements Summary & Verification

```mindmap
AB-01 Stage 2 Model
  Levels
    Ground Floor (0 mm)
    Upper Floor (3600 mm)
  Walls (16 total)
    8 Ground Floor boundary walls
    8 Upper Floor boundary walls
  Openings (18 total)
    Doors (6 total)
      D-GF-01 (West courtyard wall)
      D-GF-02 (North courtyard wall)
      D-GF-03 (East courtyard wall)
      D-UF-01 (West courtyard wall)
      D-UF-02 (North courtyard wall)
      D-UF-03 (East courtyard wall)
    Windows (12 total)
      W-GF-W1, W-GF-W2 (GF West)
      W-GF-N1, W-GF-N2 (GF North)
      W-GF-E1, W-GF-E2 (GF East)
      W-UF-W1, W-UF-W2 (UF West)
      W-UF-N1, W-UF-N2 (UF North)
      W-UF-E1, W-UF-E2 (UF East)
  Slabs (34 total)
    Building Slabs (7 total)
    Stair Treads (23 total)
    Site Slab (1 total)
    Courtyard Pond (1 total)
    Planter Beds (2 total)
  Roofs (3 total)
```

---

### 🚪 Doors & Windows

* **Courtyard Entry Doors (6 total, 1.2 m W × 2.4 m H)**:
  * **Ground Floor**:
    * `D-GF-01` (`10aa02db-d162-4967-bd6e-bb3e353542ca`): Hosted on `34326fca-431a-4d4f-be51-dd34f0920a26` (West wing, courtyard face), centered at offset 6,000 mm.
    * `D-GF-02` (`4ca2d808-f6f1-4a58-badc-68381aa458b2`): Hosted on `201b0d64-fd2d-48c2-b675-f46879c6481c` (North wing, courtyard face), centered at offset 6,000 mm.
    * `D-GF-03` (`6cea66a0-2a9c-4f53-95bf-0619e67c1208`): Hosted on `692a190a-c78c-4574-87cb-93fec89f700d` (East wing, courtyard face), centered at offset 6,000 mm.
  * **Upper Floor** (*Conceptual openings for benchmark geometry only; no compliant access or constructability claimed*):
    * `D-UF-01` (`fac82101-5dc6-4479-a048-ac3d4f2b1e24`): Hosted on `a426e762-5999-472e-a230-f8b7900bd4b1` (West wing, courtyard face), centered at offset 6,000 mm.
    * `D-UF-02` (`edc6cc8c-6a92-467c-a38f-e7eb6a0c1d0a`): Hosted on `a920f31e-947c-478c-a2bf-d4880b929f3c` (North wing, courtyard face), centered at offset 6,000 mm.
    * `D-UF-03` (`0ade4e46-7f87-4b78-83fa-ea1e7d644374`): Hosted on `33108938-bb25-4575-948f-a39b0fc937ed` (East wing, courtyard face), centered at offset 6,000 mm.

* **Exterior Windows (12 total, 1.8 m W × 1.5 m H, 0.9 m sill)**:
  * **Ground Floor Outer Perimeter**:
    * West wall (`0c36c356-ef2d-4fc6-bfb9-d97b476bff2e`): `W-GF-W1` (offset 6,000 mm) & `W-GF-W2` (offset 12,000 mm).
    * North wall (`95bfd96f-24bf-47c7-9b30-33aa1543507e`): `W-GF-N1` (offset 8,000 mm) & `W-GF-N2` (offset 16,000 mm).
    * East wall (`89b5ba53-2853-4b27-8946-07f894a94d87`): `W-GF-E1` (offset 6,000 mm) & `W-GF-E2` (offset 12,000 mm).
  * **Upper Floor Outer Perimeter**:
    * West wall (`b0ecba24-8c98-406f-811c-127ac4ff33f9`): `W-UF-W1` (offset 6,000 mm) & `W-UF-W2` (offset 12,000 mm).
    * North wall (`eb5a2608-e831-49df-b931-8af384d75e44`): `W-UF-N1` (offset 8,000 mm) & `W-UF-N2` (offset 16,000 mm).
    * East wall (`c08cee0c-7f70-4d63-9b78-c59d8b23a3dc`): `W-UF-E1` (offset 6,000 mm) & `W-UF-E2` (offset 12,000 mm).
  * All windows are positioned clear of doors and evenly spaced along their respective exterior wall spans.

---

### 🪜 Internal Stair Geometry

* **Classification Disclosure**: The stair is a **geometric approximation** constructed using 23 discrete supported `slab` elements. The workbench schema does not possess a native parametric stair entity.
* **Geometry & Spacing**:
  * Positioned inside the reserved west-wing void ($X \in [2400, 3600]\,\text{mm}$).
  * 23 visible treads (`Tread-01` to `Tread-23`), each $1,200\,\text{mm}$ wide, $300\,\text{mm}$ deep, and $50\,\text{mm}$ thick, assigned material `"Timber"`.
  * Rises: 24 equal rises of $150\,\text{mm}$ starting from ground level ($0\,\text{mm}$) up to the upper floor elevation ($3,600\,\text{mm}$).
  * Alignment: Treads ascend from $Y = 5,700\,\text{mm}$ to $Y = 12,600\,\text{mm}$.
  * Upper Floor Connection: The uppermost tread (`Tread-23`, offset $+3,450\,\text{mm}$, top edge at $Y = 12,600\,\text{mm}$) abuts the upper floor slab landing (`UF-Slab-West-North`, edge at $Y = 12,600\,\text{mm}$) with **$0\,\text{mm}$ horizontal gap**. The final $150\,\text{mm}$ rise steps directly onto the upper-floor finished slab level.
  * The stairwell void remains open above the run, with no floor slabs obstructing the flight.

---

### 🌳 Site Slab & Courtyard Elements

* **Site Slab** (`cb82ff24-6e88-49c6-990f-3d7e2e2ddb95`, `"Site-Slab"`):
  * Dimensions: $32.0\,\text{m} \times 26.0\,\text{m}$ ($X \in [-4000, 28000]\,\text{mm}$, $Y \in [-4000, 22000]\,\text{mm}$), providing uniform $4\,\text{m}$ margins around the $24\,\text{m} \times 18\,\text{m}$ building envelope.
  * Elevation & Thickness: Top at $-0.3\,\text{m}$ (offset $-300\,\text{mm}$), thickness $0.2\,\text{m}$ ($200\,\text{mm}$), material `"Site Concrete"`.

* **Courtyard Pond** (`34e6e935-b7fd-4ae9-b995-b5ad13dfa8ab`, `"Courtyard-Pond"`):
  * Dimensions: $6.0\,\text{m} \times 3.0\,\text{m}$ ($X \in [9000, 15000]\,\text{mm}$, $Y \in [1000, 4000]\,\text{mm}$).
  * Surface & Thickness: Top water surface at $-0.1\,\text{m}$ (offset $-100\,\text{mm}$), thickness $200\,\text{mm}$, material explicitly named `"Water"`.
  * Placement: Centered horizontally in the southern courtyard zone, maintaining $\ge 2,000\,\text{mm}$ clearance from all wing entry doors.

* **Raised Planter Beds (2 total)**:
  * West Bed (`60b8832f-2c69-4c44-a574-493aebfa6f96`, `"Planter-Bed-West"`): $4.0\,\text{m} \times 1.0\,\text{m}$ ($X \in [6500, 10500]\,\text{mm}$, $Y \in [8500, 9500]\,\text{mm}$).
  * East Bed (`f0486ac5-b329-458c-bc3c-aeb2b06885bb`, `"Planter-Bed-East"`): $4.0\,\text{m} \times 1.0\,\text{m}$ ($X \in [13500, 17500]\,\text{mm}$, $Y \in [8500, 9500]\,\text{mm}$).
  * Elevation & Thickness: Top at $+0.6\,\text{m}$ (offset $+600\,\text{mm}$), thickness $600\,\text{mm}$, material explicitly named `"Planting"`.
  * Clearance: Separated by a central $3.0\,\text{m}$ walkway leading to the North courtyard door, clear of each other, pond, and all doorways.

* **Renderer Material Display Disclosure**:
  * While the materials are recorded as `"Water"` and `"Planting"` in the project data, the active solid 3D canvas uses a shared material shader with standard geometric shading. It does not provide physically distinct procedural water caustics, foliage textures, or transparency.

---

### 🔍 Verified Entity Counts & Limitations

* **Design Status**: Revision `8`, saved and readback-verified.
* **Storeys**: 2 levels (`Ground Floor` at $0\,\text{mm}$, `Upper Floor` at $3,600\,\text{mm}$).
* **Walls**: 16 total exterior walls.
* **Openings**: 18 total (6 doors, 12 windows).
* **Slabs**: 34 total (1 GF building slab, 6 UF split slabs, 23 stair treads, 1 site slab, 1 pond slab, 2 planter bed slabs).
* **Roofs**: 3 flat roof zones over the building footprint.
* **Model Viewer**: Successfully mounted in solid display mode under scene hash `2dcfd3839480e59d885e603fb762d4bfd8b67e5874a3597d4616984704f79b76`.
* **Remaining Limitations**: This benchmark model is an illustrative internal draft (`xray.internal-draft/1`). It is uncalibrated against real-world survey datum and does not represent an engineered, compliant, or construction-ready release. Upper-level courtyard doors function as conceptual geometric openings without balustrades or egress decks.

Current X-Ray project ID: job-1b0c3d86-4ecf-4be8-9297-cd9f74c616a3
Architectural benchmark AB-01: Courtyard Learning Centre. This is an illustrative, unverified design exercise, not a measured reconstruction or construction issue. Work in Model view using actual architectural tool calls. Never draw geometry by writing code or provide a raster substitute.

Stage 1: Build the complete structural wireframe. Use metres in this brief and millimetres in the tools. Plan north is positive Y, east positive X, with the southwest outside corner at (0,0). The building's outer dimensions are 24 m east-west by 18 m north-south. It is U-shaped: west and east wings are each 6 m wide, linked by a north wing 6 m deep, leaving a 12 m wide by 12 m deep courtyard open to the south. Two levels at 0 and 3.6 m, each 3.6 m high. Exactly the eight exterior boundary walls on each level; no internal partitions. Ground floor slab 250 mm thick under the U footprint, with its top at 0. Upper floor slab 250 mm thick with its top at 3.6 m. Flat roof at 7.2 m, with zero eaves and the same U footprint; do not cover the courtyard.

Reserve a 1.2 m by 7.2 m straight stairwell wholly inside the west wing, open through the upper floor, with adequate space at both ends. Build the upper floor around this opening using supported geometry. Stairs and openings come in stage 2. Read back your geometry and verify dimensions, levels and courtyard/stairwell openings. Save it, mount it in Model mode as wireframe and capture the real view. Explain unsupported items and actual failures hones

Architectural benchmark AB-01: Courtyard Learning Centre. This is an illustrative, unverified design exercise, not a measured reconstruction or construction issue. Work in Model view using actual architectural tool calls. Never draw geometry by writing code or provide a raster substitute.

Stage 1: Build the complete structural wireframe. Use metres in this brief and millimetres in the tools. Plan north is positive Y, east positive X, with the southwest outside corner at (0,0). The building's outer dimensions are 24 m east-west by 18 m north-south. It is U-shaped: west and east wings are each 6 m wide, linked by a north wing 6 m deep, leaving a 12 m wide by 12 m deep courtyard open to the south. Two levels at 0 and 3.6 m, each 3.6 m high. Exactly the eight exterior boundary walls on each level; no internal partitions. Ground floor slab 250 mm thick under the U footprint, with its top at 0. Upper floor slab 250 mm thick with its top at 3.6 m. Flat roof at 7.2 m, with zero eaves and the same U footprint; do not cover the courtyard.

Reserve a 1.2 m by 7.2 m straight stairwell wholly inside the west wing, open through the upper floor, with adequate space at both ends. Build the upper floor around this opening using supported geometry. Stairs and openings come in stage 2. Read back your geometry and verify dimensions, levels and courtyard/stairwell openings. Save it, mount it in Model mode as wireframe and capture the real view. Explain unsupported items and actual failures hones

Current X-Ray project ID: job-1b0c3d86-4ecf-4be8-9297-cd9f74c616a3
Architectural benchmark AB-01: Courtyard Learning Centre. This is an illustrative, unverified design exercise, not a measured reconstruction or construction issue. Work in Model view using actual architectural tool calls. Never draw geometry by writing code or provide a raster substitute.

Stage 1: Build the complete structural wireframe. Use metres in this brief and millimetres in the tools. Plan north is positive Y, east positive X, with the southwest outside corner at (0,0). The building's outer dimensions are 24 m east-west by 18 m north-south. It is U-shaped: west and east wings are each 6 m wide, linked by a north wing 6 m deep, leaving a 12 m wide by 12 m deep courtyard open to the south. Two levels at 0 and 3.6 m, each 3.6 m high. Exactly the eight exterior boundary walls on each level; no internal partitions. Ground floor slab 250 mm thick under the U footprint, with its top at 0. Upper floor slab 250 mm thick with its top at 3.6 m. Flat roof at 7.2 m, with zero eaves and the same U footprint; do not cover the courtyard.

Reserve a 1.2 m by 7.2 m straight stairwell wholly inside the west wing, open through the upper floor, with adequate space at both ends. Build the upper floor around this opening using supported geometry. Stairs and openings come in stage 2. Read back your geometry and verify dimensions, levels and courtyard/stairwell openings. Save it, mount it in Model mode as wireframe and capture the real view. Explain unsupported items and actual failures hones

Current X-Ray project ID: job-1b0c3d86-4ecf-4be8-9297-cd9f74c616a3
Architectural benchmark AB-01: Courtyard Learning Centre. This is an illustrative, unverified design exercise, not a measured reconstruction or construction issue. Work in Model view using actual architectural tool calls. Never draw geometry by writing code or provide a raster substitute.

Stage 1: Build the complete structural wireframe. Use metres in this brief and millimetres in the tools. Plan north is positive Y, east positive X, with the southwest outside corner at (0,0). The building's outer dimensions are 24 m east-west by 18 m north-south. It is U-shaped: west and east wings are each 6 m wide, linked by a north wing 6 m deep, leaving a 12 m wide by 12 m deep courtyard open to the south. Two levels at 0 and 3.6 m, each 3.6 m high. Exactly the eight exterior boundary walls on each level; no internal partitions. Ground floor slab 250 mm thick under the U footprint, with its top at 0. Upper floor slab 250 mm thick with its top at 3.6 m. Flat roof at 7.2 m, with zero eaves and the same U footprint; do not cover the courtyard.

Reserve a 1.2 m by 7.2 m straight stairwell wholly inside the west wing, open through the upper floor, with adequate space at both ends. Build the upper floor around this opening using supported geometry. Stairs and openings come in stage 2. Read back your geometry and verify dimensions, levels and courtyard/stairwell openings. Save it, mount it in Model mode as wireframe and capture the real view. Explain unsupported items and actual failures hones

Current X-Ray project ID: job-1b0c3d86-4ecf-4be8-9297-cd9f74c616a3
Architectural benchmark AB-01: Courtyard Learning Centre. This is an illustrative, unverified design exercise, not a measured reconstruction or construction issue. Work in Model view using actual architectural tool calls. Never draw geometry by writing code or provide a raster substitute.

Stage 1: Build the complete structural wireframe. Use metres in this brief and millimetres in the tools. Plan north is positive Y, east positive X, with the southwest outside corner at (0,0). The building's outer dimensions are 24 m east-west by 18 m north-south. It is U-shaped: west and east wings are each 6 m wide, linked by a north wing 6 m deep, leaving a 12 m wide by 12 m deep courtyard open to the south. Two levels at 0 and 3.6 m, each 3.6 m high. Exactly the eight exterior boundary walls on each level; no internal partitions. Ground floor slab 250 mm thick under the U footprint, with its top at 0. Upper floor slab 250 mm thick with its top at 3.6 m. Flat roof at 7.2 m, with zero eaves and the same U footprint; do not cover the courtyard.

Reserve a 1.2 m by 7.2 m straight stairwell wholly inside the west wing, open through the upper floor, with adequate space at both ends. Build the upper floor around this opening using supported geometry. Stairs and openings come in stage 2. Read back your geometry and verify dimensions, levels and courtyard/stairwell openings. Save it, mount it in Model mode as wireframe and capture the real view. Explain unsupported items and actual failures hones

Current X-Ray project ID: job-1b0c3d86-4ecf-4be8-9297-cd9f74c616a3
Architectural benchmark AB-01: Courtyard Learning Centre. This is an illustrative, unverified design exercise, not a measured reconstruction or construction issue. Work in Model view using actual architectural tool calls. Never draw geometry by writing code or provide a raster substitute.

Stage 1: Build the complete structural wireframe. Use metres in this brief and millimetres in the tools. Plan north is positive Y, east positive X, with the southwest outside corner at (0,0). The building's outer dimensions are 24 m east-west by 18 m north-south. It is U-shaped: west and east wings are each 6 m wide, linked by a north wing 6 m deep, leaving a 12 m wide by 12 m deep courtyard open to the south. Two levels at 0 and 3.6 m, each 3.6 m high. Exactly the eight exterior boundary walls on each level; no internal partitions. Ground floor slab 250 mm thick under the U footprint, with its top at 0. Upper floor slab 250 mm thick with its top at 3.6 m. Flat roof at 7.2 m, with zero eaves and the same U footprint; do not cover the courtyard.

Reserve a 1.2 m by 7.2 m straight stairwell wholly inside the west wing, open through the upper floor, with adequate space at both ends. Build the upper floor around this opening using supported geometry. Stairs and openings come in stage 2. Read back your geometry and verify dimensions, levels and courtyard/stairwell openings. Save it, mount it in Model mode as wireframe and capture the real view. Explain unsupported items and actual failures hones

parts.text:
### 📐 Structural Wireframe Model Built

I have constructed the two-storey U-shaped structural wireframe for the Courtyard Learning Centre in the Architectural workspace, verified all geometry and openings, saved the project record, mounted it in Model mode as a wireframe scene, and captured the live 3D view.

---

### 🏛️ Hierarchy and Layout

```mindmap
AB-01 Courtyard Learning Centre
  Ground Floor (0.0 m to 3.6 m)
    8 exterior boundary walls
    250 mm ground floor slab
    Open southern courtyard (12 m x 12 m)
  Upper Floor (3.6 m to 7.2 m)
    8 exterior boundary walls
    250 mm floor slab panels
    Stairwell opening (1.2 m x 7.2 m)
  Roof (7.2 m)
    3 flat roof zones (0 pitch, 0 eaves)
    Courtyard unroofed
```

---

### 🧱 Level and Element Verification

#### 1. Storey Levels
* **Ground Floor** (`a7a0093e-ae22-4bd8-88f0-ba49a3bde758`): Elevation `0 mm`, height `3600 mm`.
* **Upper Floor** (`df8252dd-c9ca-4a2a-a764-52a2034902d6`): Elevation `3600 mm`, height `3600 mm`.

#### 2. Exterior Boundary Walls (8 per level, 16 total)
Each wall is 3600 mm high, tracking the 24 m × 18 m outer U-shape with a 12 m × 12 m open south courtyard:
* **West wing south wall**: (0, 0) to (6000, 0) mm — Ground `2a1433fb-fe5b-47f2-9720-9b7836be5ffd`, Upper `f7b3058f-82b6-4b13-80f2-b32ec0545f7d` (6.0 m).
* **Courtyard west inner wall**: (6000, 0) to (6000, 12000) mm — Ground `34326fca-431a-4d4f-be51-dd34f0920a26`, Upper `a426e762-5999-472e-a230-f8b7900bd4b1` (12.0 m).
* **Courtyard north inner wall**: (6000, 12000) to (18000, 12000) mm — Ground `201b0d64-fd2d-48c2-b675-f46879c6481c`, Upper `a920f31e-947c-478c-a2bf-d4880b929f3c` (12.0 m).
* **Courtyard east inner wall**: (18000, 12000) to (18000, 0) mm — Ground `692a190a-c78c-4574-87cb-93fec89f700d`, Upper `33108938-bb25-4575-948f-a39b0fc937ed` (12.0 m).
* **East wing south wall**: (18000, 0) to (24000, 0) mm — Ground `6f246fc6-fba2-4b5c-8091-bbe2e07347ff`, Upper `c4943dec-9e43-44f4-9b5b-ab012a269f88` (6.0 m).
* **East wing outer wall**: (24000, 0) to (24000, 18000) mm — Ground `89b5ba53-2853-4b27-8946-07f894a94d87`, Upper `c08cee0c-7f70-4d63-9b78-c59d8b23a3dc` (18.0 m).
* **North wing outer wall**: (24000, 18000) to (0, 18000) mm — Ground `95bfd96f-24bf-47c7-9b30-33aa1543507e`, Upper `eb5a2608-e831-49df-b931-8af384d75e44` (24.0 m).
* **West wing outer wall**: (0, 18000) to (0, 0) mm — Ground `0c36c356-ef2d-4fc6-bfb9-d97b476bff2e`, Upper `b0ecba24-8c98-406f-811c-127ac4ff33f9` (18.0 m).

#### 3. Slabs and Stairwell Void
* **Ground floor slab** (`afb1a1c4-2d7f-429d-b34d-d0101a98dbfa`): Continuous 250 mm thick concrete slab following the 8-point U-footprint, top at elevation 0 mm.
* **Stairwell opening**: Positioned at X: [2400, 3600] mm and Y: [5400, 12600] mm inside the west wing. This reserves exactly 1.2 m × 7.2 m, providing 2.4 m clear passage on both sides and 5.4 m clear floor space at both north and south ends.
* **Upper floor slab panels**: Because native slabs cannot hold negative internal voids within a single perimeter, the upper floor (top at 3.6 m, thickness 250 mm) is framed around the stairwell void using six contiguous rectangular slabs:
  * South west wing (`2aea528a-1407-4943-a7db-fc79dbda3a02`): [0, 6000] × [0, 5400] mm.
  * West flank strip (`b951177d-2107-43b0-ba15-9980bb2346e9`): [0, 2400] × [5400, 12600] mm.
  * East flank strip (`dae85a4a-cb35-45cf-9e39-2bb84ab722e1`): [3600, 6000] × [5400, 12600] mm.
  * North west wing (`91409341-a494-4ae8-8352-79ab0a7fddfa`): [0, 6000] × [12600, 18000] mm.
  * North wing (`d539f8fa-d54e-41ea-9a40-6a84d9df9fe6`): [6000, 18000] × [12000, 18000] mm.
  * East wing (`48ca270a-cb74-4614-81f9-603434b4ac05`): [18000, 24000] × [0, 18000] mm.

#### 4. Flat Roof
* System constraints require roof boundaries to be convex zones. The concave U-footprint flat roof (elevation 7.2 m, 0 mm eaves, 0° pitch) was placed using three contiguous rectangular zones on the Upper Floor level with a 3600 mm vertical offset:
  * West wing roof (`f67ad274-6369-4a33-88a7-d4eb106fd9b5`): [0, 6000] × [0, 18000] mm.
  * North wing roof (`2e85a2a3-a6d3-4ac9-82c1-6887c72eafc9`): [6000, 18000] × [12000, 18000] mm.
  * East wing roof (`1fd2d1c1-ae75-436c-8d89-b1d5d57f6fab`): [18000, 24000] × [0, 18000] mm.
* The 12 m × 12 m courtyard remains completely open to the sky.

---

### 📋 Technical Disclosures and Blockers

* **Unsupported void cutouts**: Architectural slabs do not accept isolated interior void rings. The stairwell penetration was modelled by subdividing the upper floor slab into modular panels around the 1.2 m × 7.2 m void.
* **Convex roof constraint**: Roof geometry requires convex polygons; a monolithic concave U-shape was resolved into three abutting convex roof rectangles.
* **Wall assembly**: All 16 boundary walls utilize the unpriced default 260 mm multi-layer assembly (110 mm brick, 50 mm cavity, 90 mm stud, 10 mm plasterboard).
* **Data status**: As specified in the work packet, this is an illustrative, unverified internal draft design without governing source calibration or professional engineering sign-off.

packets.objective:
Continue AB-01 in the same project. Preserve the completed U-shaped two-storey structure and stairwell. This is stage 2, an illustrative benchmark. Work through actual tools, save, inspect and mount the final Model in solid view; capture the real result.

Add exactly six doors: three on each level, one centered on each of the west-wing, east-wing and north-wing courtyard-facing walls. Each door is 1.2 m wide by 2.4 m high. For this geometric benchmark, the upper-level doors are conceptual openings; do not claim compliant access or constructability. Add twelve windows: six per level, two on each outer west, north and east wall, evenly distributed and clear of doors. Each is 1.8 m wide by 1.5 m high with a 0.9 m sill.

Build one straight internal stair inside the reserved west-wing void: 24 rises of 150 mm reaching the upper floor, with 23 visible treads, each 1.2 m wide, 300 mm deep and 50 mm thick. The uppermost tread must meet the upper-floor landing without a horizontal gap. Do not fill the stairwell or put a floor over the treads. Use supported geometry and clearly disclose whether the stair is a native stair object or a geometric approximation.

Add a rectangular 32 m by 26 m site slab, giving 4 m margins around the building, with top at -0.3 m and thickness 0.2 m. Inside the courtyard add one 6 m by 3 m pond with water surface at -0.1 m, and two separate raised planted beds, each 4 m by 1 m with top at +0.6 m. Keep them clear of each other and entry doors. Give water and planting explicit material names, and report if the renderer cannot display them distinctly. No extra levels, walls, fake source evidence, unrelated catalog buildings, images in place of geometry, or construction-ready claims. Read the final saved design and report actual counts and remaining limitations.
